properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From late Sunday night until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 AM EDT Friday the stage was 7.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
Monday morning and continue rising to 12.2 feet Monday morning.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.2
feet on 11/24/1997.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 4:12PM MDT until September 11 at 5:15PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:

heavy rain across areas near Hole in the Rock Road, including Zebra,
Peekaboo, and Headless Hen Canyons, plus Coyote Gulch and Forty Mile
Gulch. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Areas near Hole in the Rock Road and the Escalante River, including
Zebra, Peekaboo, and Headless Hen Canyons, plus Coyote Gulch and
Forty Mile Gulch.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.
